images.author: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
images.why: Caption confirms colourised TEM of H1N1 influenza particles, with surface proteins shown in black. Green particles against blue provide strong contrast; square composition suits a 9:10 crop. Linked Flickr size is limited to 1024 px.

images.source: CDC Public Health Image Library; JPEG hosted in CDC archive
images.author: Cynthia Goldsmith; content provider CDC/Dr. Terrence Tumpey
images.why: Caption confirms colourised negative-stain TEM of reconstructed 1918 influenza virions collected from infected cell cultures. Particularly relevant to a deadliest-viruses ranking. Direct CDC JPEG download; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.source: CDC Public Health Image Library; full-size copy hosted by U.S. Department of Defense
images.author: CDC/C. S. Goldsmith and A. Balish
images.why: Caption identifies colourised TEM of 2009 pandemic influenza A(H1N1), showing variable-shaped virions with distinct spikes. Green particles against purple offer strong colour contrast. Full-size government-hosted copy; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: John Gallagher and Audray Harris, NIAID Laboratory of Infectious Diseases; NIAID/NIH
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies blue influenza A/H1N1 particles imaged by colourised TEM. Useful alternative colour palette. Linked Flickr size is limited to 1024 px; original-resolution download could not be verified.

images.author: CDC/Cynthia Goldsmith
images.why: Caption confirms colourised TEM of 2009 pandemic A(H1N1), with spherical virions, visible internal nucleocapsid sections and prominent surrounding spikes. Lower-resolution fallback: this direct URL is the preview; the page separately lists a 6.94 MB high-resolution file.

images.author: CDC/C. S. Goldsmith and A. Balish
images.why: Caption confirms colourised TEM of spherical 2009 pandemic A(H1N1) virions surrounded by distinct spikes. Lower-resolution fallback: this direct URL is the preview; the page separately lists an 11.45 MB high-resolution file.
